mechanism_narrative: A continuing recovery in WORKPLACES mobility increases weekday foot traffic and adjacent retail errands, so RETAIL_REC rises over the next four weeks relative to the prior four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not exceed its prior 28-day mean over the next 28 days while WORKPLACES stays at or above its current level.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL mobility falls below its recent average, more people leave home for discretionary shopping and dining, pushing RETAIL_REC higher within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL drops below 4% on a weekly mean
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise above the last 28-day average within 14 days after RESIDENTIAL drops below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in GROCERY_PHARM together with PARKS indicates broader out-of-home activity, and that mix spills into retail visits, increasing RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to improve over the next 28 days despite both GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS remaining above their current weekly means.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT remains deeply depressed while WORKPLACES also stay weak, the city is in a constrained commuting regime that suppresses discretionary stopovers, keeping RETAIL_REC lower over the next month.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT stays below -25% for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its prior 28-day mean during the next 28 days while TRANSIT remains below -25% for two straight weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in PARKS mobility above its already elevated level reflects weather or leisure seasonality that reallocates trips away from indoor retail, causing RETAIL_REC to soften over the next week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above 65% after already being above 50%
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall below the last 28-day mean within 7 days after PARKS rises above 65%.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM strengthens while RESIDENTIAL eases, households are mixing essential trips with discretionary errands, and that cross-purpose behavior lifts RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains at or below its prior 28-day mean over the next 28 days even though GROCERY_PHARM stays above baseline and RESIDENTIAL stays below its recent peak.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in TRANSIT above its current depressed band is a leading indicator of eased access to shopping districts, so RETAIL_REC improves within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises by at least 5 points from the prior week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase above the last 28-day average within 14 days after TRANSIT rises by at least 5 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES stay weak while TRANSIT does not recover, commuting-linked retail demand remains suppressed and RETAIL_REC continues to underperform over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC exceeds its prior 28-day mean over the next 28 days while WORKPLACES stays below -15% and TRANSIT stays below -20%.
